palette_rationale: Exact approved 63-color Idle palette for all action sheets; preserve native red eyes and mouth under source-only one-pixel lower eye rule.
reference: Native chr515 clips and anatomy provide the motion; no separate PMDO reference pose or pixels used.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native bouncing locomotion with open-mouth rise and independently swinging tail. J_center XZ travel locked; source Y retained. Loop endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native jaw-open forward body strike; contact near .18-.28s. Horizontal native travel locked, vertical recoil retained.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native wide-mouth body release near1.5s, tail upright; no verified projectile/effect asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native low breathing rest; source b01 closed-eye row selected atV+.25, no black open-eye edge postprocess.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native head/body recoil with rearward tail swing; avoids bd02 extreme vertical travel.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Source three-bone tail sweep and head turn; tail is actual appendage, no invented hand.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two retimed native jaw/body strikes; two visual contacts, one PMDO HitFrame. Horizontal travel locked.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Distinct native high vertical body arc, selected to separate Hop from br01 Walk and ba01 Attack; no procedural lift.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Source centerY rising body/tail buildup then mirrored release to neutral; no invented glow/effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native tail/head looking gesture plus explicit whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
